agreements: PCFL-Stream is scientifically viable as the single candidate paper family only as a finite-range, fixed-source/off-policy synthetic causal benchmark of compiled per-life memory; it cannot establish on-policy self-improvement, autonomous discovery, naturalistic external validity, generic intelligence, unbounded continual learning, or superiority or saturation of unnamed SOTA systems.

One target-independent source behavior policy must generate a common immutable public action--outcome chronology before arm assignment. Evaluation actions do not change later source evidence or trigger durable recompilation in Paper 1.

The complete target/cohort/depth/age manifest must be total, rejection-free, and presealed before realized source support, compiler output, calibration outcomes, or arm results; introduced, supported, compiled, and action-usable coverage are separate denominators and every assigned failure remains in inference.

The compiler may see the sealed source prefix and eligible provenance only, never evaluation goals, target templates or allocation, hidden truth or proof certificates, arm or capacity assignments, prior outcomes, or any derived channel carrying them. Descendant visibility, taint, and reset obligations extend through rendering, allocation, compilation, training, reading, candidates, prompts, parsing, execution, scoring, auditing, caches, handles, RNG, and errors.

The compiled-text gate is calibration-only. It may stop a later LoRA request, but after a pass every preassigned fresh confirmation corpus must enter every scheduled text and LoRA treatment without per-life usefulness or outcome-conditioned admission, and no gate automatically dispatches the next stage.

Whole world-life/twin pairs are the independent confirmation units; checkpoints, targets, depths, ages, sides, model calls, and training seeds are nested observations. Pair counts, margins, estimators, multiplicity, and zero-versus-NOT_RUN handling must be frozen from blinded variance or conservative power work rather than inherited from the four-pair J/P DEV screen.

Same-corpus text-versus-LoRA comparison isolates semantic source content only. Substrate and reader must be crossed at preregistered sentinel cells, with candidate-only, no-adapter, wrong/twin-adapter, explicit text/index, recognition-assisted, and unaided-LoRA controls plus complete information and resource ledgers.

LoRA binding-causal credit requires paired authentic-versus-target-byte-equivalent twin-trained whole-life adapters on primary items and a small preregistered decisive-binding versus sham-cut panel with matched initialization, optimizer, example order, exposure, and training seeds. Citation masking alone is not a parametric causal cut.

Depth is an independently certified graph-theoretic minimum over life-specific causal bindings, with alternate proofs enumerated, nuisance marginals matched, and an eligible typed controller achieving itemwise value one under the exact caps. Cross-era success is resolver composition over compiled local atoms unless an endpoint-held graph-edge intervention reduces action value.

A named baseline's plateau is an equivalence claim about that exact frozen implementation and legitimate resource policy over consecutive post-native increments with simultaneous pair-level uncertainty. PCFL growth and endpoint superiority are separate estimands; superiority never implies plateau.

Fixed rank or parameter count does not establish compression. Paper 1 must use compiled per-life parametric memory or a finite observed-range rate--distortion/storage frontier unless exact serialized incremental bits and every information-bearing external object are sublinear at a predeclared noninferior action value. PCFL-Schema and semantic-compression discovery are deferred to a separately prospective change.

The feasible paper surface is staged: CPU construct and shortcut certification, disjoint compiled-text calibration, a sentinel LoRA reader/causal panel, then one locked full-lifetime confirmation over core arms, with depths 1 and 4 primary, depths 2 and 3 sparse unless powered, one primary capacity plus a fixed-capacity reference, and all omitted, failed, or NOT_RUN cells visible.

Independent review is a reproducibility and evidence-to-claim gate, not a forced positive outcome. Approve-narrow, null, NOT_RUN, and reject are all valid terminal verdicts; an author-side advocate cannot override rejection and repaired bytes require fresh bound review.

This consensus creates no authority. Human ratification remains required and implementation_authorized remains false; model or provider use, network access, training, GPU work, confirmation, promotion, claim release, and automatic successor dispatch are explicitly forbidden, as are attempts to inherit authority or paper evidence from the J/P DEV or Bubblewrap CPU consensuses.

disagreements.issue: Whether the proposed single-family headline and 'its own life' or amortized-agent wording can represent a general self-learning-agent result when source experience is common and fixed and the compiler class is unspecified.

positions.position: Make PCFL-Stream the sole paper endpoint and describe an agent compiling its growing action--outcome life into later action improvement, while retiring only the explicit on-policy flywheel claim.

The matched common source is a causal strength but makes the study fixed-source/off-policy; exact compiler attribution and benchmark-specific finite-range language are mandatory, and generic SOTA, on-policy, or broad self-learning wording is unearned.

resolution.rationale: The owner clarified better eventual action, not faster learning, as the hypothesis. Internal causal attribution is strongest with a single preassignment source policy, but that design does not let memory change evidence acquisition. The claim must therefore name the frozen compiler class, resolver, generator, exact compared systems, and finite PCFL range.
resolution.selected_position: Retain PCFL-Stream only as the single candidate fixed-source/off-policy synthetic causal benchmark and defer every on-policy, generic-SOTA, external-validity, autonomous-discovery, and unbounded-lifetime claim.
resolution.required_change: Rework the proposal's graph, loop, claim sentences, source-policy contract, target-execution state machine, and human boundary so no phrase implies policy-selected source experience or an unnamed-system result; name the compiler accurately and prewrite only finite PCFL claims.

disagreements.issue: Whether the aggregate visibility matrix, supported-mapping axis, and 'only a causally useful corpus' text-to-LoRA edge prevent target, life, or corpus selection from realized support, compiler success, or earlier outcomes.

positions.position: The six-stage matrix, target-blind compiler language, and text-causal-use prerequisite sufficiently protect the treatment and avoid waste.

Prefix and goals are incorrectly combined, descendant leakage channels are omitted, and the useful-corpus prerequisite permits post-treatment selection; targets and confirmation corpora must be assigned before support or compilation is observed.

resolution.rationale: Outcome-conditioned target or corpus admission removes the pipeline failures that the end-to-end estimand must measure. High-level forbidden labels also do not close filenames, ordering, candidates, lengths, latency, retries, errors, caches, and state carryover.
resolution.selected_position: Preseal a total target manifest, retain every assigned outcome, separate prefix from goals, enforce descendant-level taint/reset closure, and restrict the text gate to disjoint aggregate calibration only.
resolution.required_change: Replace the target-selection, text-to-LoRA edge, and visibility matrix bytes in a new proposal. Confirmation must install every assigned fresh corpus in all scheduled treatments without usefulness filtering; calibration can only produce the frozen request/stop transition and cannot repair the compiler or confirmation design.

disagreements.issue: Whether nominal depth 1--4, behavior change under citation masking, and cross-era success identify constructive depth, authentic LoRA binding causality, or learned graph connections.

positions.position: Fixed caps, cited-atom masking, twin substitution, and depth-stratified cross-era targets jointly provide causal constructive-memory evidence.

Depth and cap headroom need independent itemwise certification; action change is not directional value loss; a cited external cut does not remove a LoRA binding; and local-atom composition under a known grammar does not prove graph edges.

resolution.rationale: Depth, memory binding, and graph-edge necessity are different estimands. Environment-certified complete cuts must precede model citations, authentic/twin interventions must redirect value in the predicted direction, and distributed weights require substrate-level rather than reader-only intervention.
resolution.selected_position: Certify minimal causal-binding depth and cap headroom independently; use authentic-versus-twin whole-life adapters plus a decisive-versus-sham substrate cut for LoRA; reserve graph credit for endpoint-held edge interventions.
resolution.required_change: Rewrite T02/T03 contracts to enumerate alternate proofs, match target-visible difficulty and Bayes headroom, require typed itemwise value one under exact caps, report unconditional and authentic-success-conditioned directional action-value effects, add full-facts-with-edges-deleted and exact public sufficient-statistic controls, and forbid graph claims absent edge-specific harm with endpoint atoms held fixed.

disagreements.issue: Whether byte-identical semantic corpora and a common recognition candidate set isolate LoRA transport, parametric recall, reader cognition, and resource efficiency.

positions.position: The same corpus, source lives, targets, recognition candidates, and resolver budget make text-versus-LoRA attribution sufficiently matched.

Corpus identity controls writer content only; training exposure, rendering, reader computation, candidate enumeration, indexes, external storage, and resource policies remain causal variables that can move cognition outside the adapter.

resolution.rationale: Recognition-assisted LoRA can be a reranker over an external store that already contains the binding. A substrate claim must be conditional on a named reader interface, while efficiency requires a prospectively declared multi-resource frontier rather than a hidden common cap or a few empirical slope points.
resolution.selected_position: Use a small preregistered substrate-by-reader sentinel factorial and complete byte, exposure, compute, candidate, latency, cache, and failure accounting; call results transport through the measured interface unless a separate resource-frontier claim passes.
resolution.required_change: Bind matched candidate-assisted text and LoRA, candidate-only clean-base/no-adapter, wrong/twin-adapter, explicit text/index, and unaided generative-LoRA cells. Count canonical and training-view bytes, repetitions/order/negatives, adapter precision, every index/embedding/candidate object, prompts, preprocessing, calls, FLOPs, latency, retained state, and amortization denominator. Restrict any query-work statement to the observed range unless an algorithmic bound is reviewed.

disagreements.issue: Whether three post-native checkpoints at provisional 2x/4x/8x anchors, generic world-life splits, and broad plateau language constitute an executable powered lifetime, retention, composition, and saturation analysis.

positions.position: At least three post-native checkpoints, pair-level normalized action value, simultaneous uncertainty, positive growth, endpoint advantage, and predeclared plateau definitions can support the lifetime and saturation claims.

Three points give only two increments; locations, sample size, value normalization, subscale nulls, margins, baseline policies, multiplicity, generator scope, and failures remain unspecified, and superiority cannot stand in for equivalence-style plateau.

resolution.rationale: The scientific scale axis is new causal information beyond the exact model-visible envelope, not powers of two themselves. Whole-life/twin-pair inference and a separately frozen ordered or intersection claim are needed because acquisition, retention, and cross-era composition have different nulls. Plateau belongs to each named baseline and cannot be inferred from an endpoint contrast.
resolution.selected_position: Treat 2x/4x/8x and three post-native points as provisional feasibility anchors; freeze the final powered checkpoint surface, pair counts, estimators, margins, and exact baseline-specific plateau rules before confirmation, with superiority analyzed separately.
resolution.required_change: Define raw and normalized value, chance/Bayes reference, clipping and pair aggregation; whole-life/twin-pair roots and nested seeds; blinded/conservative power; simultaneous intervals and multiplicity; acquisition superiority or maintenance, retention noninferiority, cross-era superiority with causal binding, overall growth, and endpoint contrasts; zero versus environment-wide NOT_RUN; and a generator-variant sentinel or an explicit one-generator claim. Name a baseline as plateaued only if its own frozen consecutive-increment equivalence rule passes under its legitimate capacity/resource frontier.

disagreements.issue: Whether fixed or sublinear adapter capacity over independent random cohorts is sufficient to preserve compression as a Paper-1 objective.

positions.position: Compression may be earned through a fixed or sublinear adapter-capacity response surface or a prospective schema.

Fixed rank can hide unused precision, external state, optimizer state, candidates, and growing training work; independent cohorts add linear fresh entropy, so semantic compression and PCFL-Schema should leave Paper 1.

resolution.rationale: Parameter count is not an information denominator and a finite range is not an asymptotic bound. Independent permutations deliberately supply no reusable meta-law, so a schema result would be a different prospective treatment rather than a rescue analysis.
resolution.selected_position: Remove semantic-compression discovery and PCFL-Schema from this paper change; permit only compiled per-life parametric memory or a finite observed-range rate--distortion/storage frontier, unless exact total incremental information is sublinear at predeclared noninferior value.
resolution.required_change: Delete compression from the Paper-1 objective and headline. If any bounded information-efficiency statement remains, freeze exact serialized adapter precision and all information-bearing external state, compare with the minimal sufficient statistic and atomic representations, require value noninferiority, and avoid asymptotic or semantic-compression language. Route PCFL-Schema through a separate material change.

disagreements.issue: Whether the implied full crossing of baselines, checkpoints, depths, ages, capacities, readers, seeds, twins, and causal cuts is a credible and selection-safe single-paper design.

positions.position: A broad factorized response surface is needed to localize compilation, storage, resolution, retention, and composition failures.
The literal Cartesian product is infeasible and invites outcome-dependent pruning; core full-surface cells and diagnostic sentinel cells must be frozen inside explicit calendar and resource bounds.

resolution.rationale: A smaller prospective surface is more informative than an unfinished or post-hoc-pruned Cartesian grid. Diagnostic attribution can be concentrated at sentinel cells while the primary lifetime curve remains balanced and powered.
resolution.selected_position: Adopt the critique's staged finite surface and explicit calendar/compute/storage/call envelope, with no automatic promotion between stages and every missing or failed cell preserved.
resolution.required_change: Freeze CPU construct certification; disjoint compiled-text calibration; a sentinel LoRA reader, twin-adapter, decisive-cut, and sham panel; and one full-lifetime confirmation over target/no-memory, honest context then truncation, one strongest frozen-calibration external-memory system, exact public sufficient statistic, direct-QA LoRA, compiled text, and compiled LoRA. Use depths 1 and 4 as balanced primary cells, depths 2/3 sparsely unless powered, one locked primary capacity plus a fixed-capacity reference, and move wider grids, extra readers/baselines, robustness, and cut diagnostics to sentinel cells. Cut schema, on-policy interaction, pointer recursion, public packaging, full grids, per-atom retraining, and new containment engineering.

disagreements.issue: Whether T06 may define success as reviewer approval and whether consensus, upstream gates, or a positive technical verdict can authorize implementation or later stages.

positions.position: The independent-review test expects the reviewer to approve only the supported narrow rung and reject overclaiming.
A valid independent review may approve-narrow, confirm a null, return NOT_RUN, or reject; advocacy cannot override it, and no model artifact or technical pass creates human or successor authority.

resolution.rationale: Predetermining approval compromises review independence and conflates reproducibility with a positive scientific finding. The canonical chain also terminates at human_required, and this rework recommendation is itself a release blocker.
resolution.selected_position: Define review success as complete access, reproducibility, explicit evidence-to-claim disposition, and preserved rejection authority; accept approve-narrow, null, NOT_RUN, and reject as terminal outcomes and preserve all authority firewalls.
resolution.required_change: Rewrite T06 and all promotion language. Prewrite finite-range claim sentences, require the reviewer to map evidence to them or reject them, keep the advocate non-overriding, and require fresh bound review after repair. Explicitly forbid implementation, model/provider/network use, training, GPUs, confirmation, promotion, claim release, and automatic successor dispatch until the applicable new proposal, exact human ratification, scoped execution, evidence, and independent-review gates exist.

A prospectively staged core/sentinel surface is necessary for feasibility, power, and selection safety.
Cross-era action can be clean-base resolver composition over local atoms; graph credit requires an endpoint-held edge intervention and schema remains separate.
The causal axis is new supported information beyond exact model-visible capacity; checkpoints must preserve adequate independent replication and power.
